purpose: Shared PREDICTION CONTRACT and evaluation universe for the target-specific councils (council_scope_v2 S6/S7). Arms may use different internal inputs; they must share rows, cutoff, target definition and output schema -- NOT one physical feature table.
row_uid: pg_ + sha256(player_id, game_id)[:16]. Derived from ids ONLY, never from date/team/season, so a later correction to a team abbreviation cannot silently move the join key.

cutoff_policy.derivation: tip time is absent from master_player, so the cutoff is game_date + 22:30 UTC, applied uniformly and recorded. It is deliberately conservative; an arm may read nothing at or after it. When true tip times are captured this becomes a new contract version, not an edit.

p_active.description: Probability the player appears in the game at all.
p_active.eligibility: every row on a slate the player's team plays, INCLUDING players who do not appear -- excluding them is the selection bias this target exists to measure
p_active.uncertainty: the probability IS the uncertainty; calibration is scored, not a variance

e_minutes_given_active.eligibility: rows where the player actually appeared (min > 0); conditioning is explicit so it is never confused with unconditional expected minutes

attempts_usage.description: Scoring opportunity: field-goal attempts per game (usage proxy).
attempts_usage.eligibility: rows where the player appeared AND team possessions are reconciled

player_scoring_distribution.description: Full predictive distribution of player points.
player_scoring_distribution.eligibility: rows where the player appeared and points are resolved
player_scoring_distribution.uncertainty: predictive sd PLUS the quantiles named in QUANTILES; a point estimate alone is NOT contract-compliant for this target

team_game_distribution.eligibility: one row per team-game with a resolved final score

prediction_schema.row_uid: canonical player-game id from this module; the join key
prediction_schema.fold_id: exact OOF fold identity; must match the contract's fold map
prediction_schema.forecast_cutoff: tz-aware ISO8601; the moment the prediction is committed
prediction_schema.pred_point: point prediction on the target's support
prediction_schema.pred_sd: predictive sd; > 0 except where the target says otherwise
prediction_schema.is_fallback: bool: a fallback path produced this, not the arm's normal path
prediction_schema.is_cold_start: bool: insufficient prior history for this player at this cutoff
prediction_schema.n_prior_games: int: strictly-prior appearances the arm could read
prediction_schema.feature_asof: tz-aware ISO8601: LATEST source observation the arm read. MUST be strictly < forecast_cutoff
prediction_schema.exclusion_reason: null if predicted; otherwise why this eligible row has no prediction. A silently missing row is a violation

fold_identity: fold_id = season:<S>; expanding walk-forward, train_boundary = seasons < S. Every prediction carries its fold so cross-arm alignment is checkable rather than assumed.
clustering_unit: game_date -- the unit all inference must cluster on
compliance: validate_predictions() REJECTS a non-compliant arm rather than repairing it. Repair would silently make incomparable things comparable, which is the failure this contract prevents.
